in_marathi.name: Giridhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Giridhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Giridhar is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots - 'Giri' meaning mountain and 'Dhar' meaning to bear. The name signifies one who bears the mountain, a powerful and majestic figure. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu who is often depicted as Giridhar, carrying the mountain Meru on his back.
